threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still call it 'the Tube' instead of 'the Overground'—everyone knows you take the Overground from here.
Caught the 133 last night—two guys were arguing about whether pineapple belongs on pizza. It got so heated the driver had to step in.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I saw a group of kids trading Pokémon cards by the canal while a couple of old folks argued over the best döner in town. Pure Neukölln magic.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you find a currywurst stand serving vegan options alongside traditional meat, all while a street artist paints a mural next door.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: Only true locals know that the taco truck on 24th and Mission has better carne asada than any sit-down place. Tourists line up for the trendy spots.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy serenading commuters on the 31-Greenwood, clutching a ukulele. Muni, with the right soundtrack, can feel like a live show sometimes.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia is all about the Gaudí hype, but they miss the real charm in the local plazas where the neighbours actually gather.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by their fresh enthusiasm for the local vermut bars—standing at the counter, deeply studying the menu like it's a treasure map.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still cross Kingsland Road at the pedestrian lights instead of just going for it. The locals don’t even look up anymore.
Last night on the 59, a bloke argued with the driver about the route. Turns out he was trying to get to Clapham Junction but just wouldn't listen. Classic!

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: I knew I was living here when the corner Kiosk ran out of currywurst at 3 AM and we all just laughed it off like it was normal.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Friedrichshain can you grab a döner at 3 AM and watch a spontaneous techno party break out in the park next door. Just another night!

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can tell a local by their casual disdain for the BART delays—only a true San Franciscan rolls their eyes at train chaos like it's a daily coffee break.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy last week at the 6th and Market stop in a full tuxedo serenading a pigeon. The bird was not impressed, but the crowd loved it.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia is just about the squares and bars, but they miss the daily hustle at the Mercat de la Llibertat, where locals actually shop.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can always spot newcomers by their hesitation at the La Boqueria's entrance—too polite to elbow their way for a jamón sandwich.
